plugins.name: knowledge-base-audit
plugins.description: Audits a project's agent knowledge base and rebuilds it: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, the docs tree and the Claude memory vault. Reports what those files cost per turn, whether their framing still matches where the commits land, what is duplicated and what is stale, then rewrites the guidance file into preflight rather than a second copy of the docs.
